title: Cozy Christmas Ambience - Fireplace & Gentle Snowfall, No Music | Christmas Cabin 8 Hours
description:
8 hours of Christmas night at Stormwood Cabin: a log fire crackling under the stockings while snow falls gently past the window and a soft winter breeze moves through the pines. No music, no bells, no talking.
The sound never loops, with a gentle fade in and a slow die-down to embers at the end. Made for falling asleep, staying asleep, reading and quiet Christmas evenings.

0:00:00 Christmas night begins
0:00:10 Fireplace and gentle snowfall (8 hours)
7:45:00 The fire slowly burns down

Stormwood Cabin - Storms outside. Warmth inside.
New sessions every Monday and Thursday.

Scenes and sounds are original, created with AI tools and edited by Stormwood Cabin.

#christmasambience #fireplace #sleepsounds
